mapper.select: select bp.bus_id, bp.supplier_id, bp.supplier_account_id, bp.product_id, bp.cost_discount, bp.sell_discount, bp.price_detail, s.name as supplier_name, sa.account_name as supplier_account_name, sa.type as supplier_account_type, p.name as product_name, p.no as product_no, p.type as product_type from crm_business_product bp left join crm_supplier s on bp.supplier_id = s.id left join crm_supplier_account sa on bp.supplier_account_id = sa.id left join crm_model_product p on bp.product_id = p.id where bp.bus_id = #{busId} order by bp.supplier_id, bp.product_id
select count(1) from crm_business_product where bus_id = #{busId}
mapper.insert:
insert into crm_business_product (bus_id, supplier_id, supplier_account_id, product_id, cost_discount, sell_discount, price_detail, creator, create_time) values

mapper.delete: delete from crm_business_product where bus_id = #{busId} and supplier_id = #{supplierId} and product_id = #{productId}
